notes: Repo has .gitmodules. Submodule commits were not vendored; submodule URLs remain in the tree.

Delta bundle contains this fork's diverging commits and tags. Prerequisite cadeef4087f5335c5eae6d1dc607f918e78a0441 must come from https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/genesis-world (still public on the capture date; compare ahead 2). A full standalone bundle was not stored because the fork is a 92457 KB copy of that upstream.
description: A generative world for general-purpose robotics & embodied AI learning.
